The "Yours, on your computer" box is now a little dark terminal window. It has red, yellow and green dots, and the heading sits in the title bar.

When you scroll to it, it types `ls ~/.trif/sites/timsrobot.com` one key at a time. Then the 10 mod files show up one after another, then the paragraph appears, and it ends on a new prompt with a blinking cursor. If your computer is set to reduce motion, it shows everything at once instead.

**Checked:** after a reload it typed the full command, showed all 10 files and the paragraph, and the screenshot looks right next to "What you need". No errors.

**One catch:** mods can't look at your files, so the file list is written into the mod. It includes this new one, `terminal.js`. If you make more mods, ask me to add them to the list.

To undo it, switch off **Terminal Box** in the side panel, or ask me to.
